name: After § 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 12b. Strongly rejects any collective, automatic or indiscriminate return of unaccompanied children or other vulnerable persons; stresses that any decision concerning the return or family reunification of unaccompanied minors must be made individually, after hearing from the child and assessing their family environment, and safety and protection needs, with full respect for the principle of non-refoulement and all applicable safeguards; underlines that family reunification is a child-protection measure and must not be used as an instrument of migration or border management;
